title: movingWindowRatio request
description: Rolling windows of days as blocks that do not overlap, one row per window named after its last day, on a relative time axis. Per block the numerator and the denominator of a share (a square in a square), as the warehouse counted them; the chart only divides. The warehouse computes the blocks; the service checks them against the chart language and draws (REQ-058).

metric.description: Identifier of the metric, e.g. creditLeads. Used as title when no title is given.

title.description: Title above the chart. States what is shown, not a conclusion.

measureType.description: Kind of number: additive or unique for a count; perUnit for a mean or median per unit where the spread between the units is the question, such as an amount per lead (REQ-070, REQ-074); ratio for a numerator divided by a denominator, only in movingWindowRatio and calendarRatio (REQ-074, REQ-076). Required until Domain Hub or the dbt YAML supplies it.

uniqueAggregation.description: Required for unique counts: daily (the uniques per day; never summed) or overPeriod (the uniques over the whole block, counted in the warehouse; only as a total).

window.description: Length of the rolling window in days: 1 for the daily values, or a multiple of 7 (another length is a tolerated deviation).

asOf.description: The last complete day of the data. A calendar period that ends after it is still running. Yesterday in Brussels when absent.

values.description: Which values are written on the chart: off, last (the last value), lastAndPrevious (the last final value in bold, a running one next to it in grey) or all (only with few points; otherwise the default is used).

numeratorName.description: What the numerator counts, as the reading cue names it: "leads".

format.description: Output format. Only svg is available in v0.

locale.description: Language of titles, labels and messages, e.g. en or nl-BE. Unknown locales fall back to English.

context.description: Provenance and status for the footer. Missing values are shown as unknown.

meta.description: Metadata of the chart (REQ-010): the question that started it, references, the query, who asked and who built it, and the day it was compiled. Only what is given is shown (REQ-020).

question.description: The question that started the chart.

references.description: Links to Jira, Slack or anything else.

query.description: The query behind the data, shown as written.

compiledOn.description: The day the chart was compiled. When absent, the day it is drawn, in Brussels.

points.description: One row per block, computed in the warehouse (REQ-058). A block without data is null or left out; it is drawn as empty, never as zero.

end.description: The last day of the window. Windows follow each other without overlap: their ends lie a whole number of windows apart.

numerator.description: The numerator of the block, such as the leads; null when the block has no data.

denominator.description: The denominator of the block, such as the visitors; null when the block has no data. The numerator of a share is part of it.
